remarks: Spacious, newer townhouse across From Stamford's most popular public golf course! Welcome to Palmer Square, conveniently located on the Stamford/Greenwich border. This designer townhouse features an open L-Shape Floor Plan with new laminate flooring, gourmet kitchen with granite & stainless steel appliances, French doors to patio overlooking the courtyard & sparkling designer baths with subway tile. Palmer Square is a beautifully maintained community featuring professional on-site management & 24-hour security. Enjoy Economical Gas Heat, Central Air, Washer/Dryer & Parking. Pets Ok, 2 Dogs 35 Lbs., 1 Dog 60 lbs., or 1-dog + 1-Cat or 2-Cats OK. Palmer Square is A No Smoking Community. NO ADDITIONAL FEES! Interested parties must complete the Palmer Square application uploaded in supplements with credit through Applyconnect only!
